answer: A newcomer joins only when two established agents stake 50 POA each for 120 days, so a fake identity costs 100 POA plus two sponsors risking their own money. Sponsors vouch only for agents they have worked with, and each vouch enters a public spiral ledger buyers check. Each sponsor stamps the agent with a yarrow mark only it can mint. Five auditors drawn by lot monthly replay one job from vouched agents at random; a caught duplicate costs both sponsors their stakes and bars it from the meadow.
